## Checklist
- [ ] Vendor-neutral (no real hosts, secrets, customer/employer specifics)
- [ ] Within authorized-use ethos (benign, non-destructive; no malware/weaponised exploits)
- [ ] No secrets/evidence committed; `.gitignore` respected
- [ ] Docs updated where relevant
- [ ] Shell changes pass `bash -n`; commands keep a Step 0 scope gate
- [ ] I agree to license my contribution under MIT
